_comment: Legends force-included into the Super Season set. Super Season is otherwise built as 'each CURRENT-POOL player's best season', which structurally excludes anyone who retired before the 2026-27 pool — 11 of the shipped 2025-26 set's 23 retro cards had no path in at all. Each entry names the season the card celebrates. Skill rides the fitted BPM bridge for seasons dunksandthrees' EPM archive does not reach (pre-2002); charts come from Basketball-Reference game logs either way. The user accepted that legend cards may run hot against modern competition.

Julius Erving.reason: first NBA season after the ABA merger, BPM 4.5

Andrei Kirilenko.reason: the archive's highest absent-player BPM at 9.2

John Stockton.reason: the last great Stockton year, BPM 5.3

Chris Paul.reason: capstone pick 2026-09-06 (rule A: no card as a Hornet) — BPM 11.0, VORP 9.9, the best season of the NOH years

Russell Westbrook.reason: capstone pick 2026-09-06 (rule A: no card as a Thunder) — the triple-double MVP year, BPM 11.1

Dwyane Wade.reason: capstone pick 2026-09-06 (rule A) — scoring title, BPM 10.6, VORP 9.6

Tracy McGrady.reason: capstone pick 2026-09-06 (rule A) — 32.1 ppg scoring title in Orlando, BPM 10.5

Clyde Drexler.reason: capstone pick 2026-09-06 (rule A) — Finals run, BPM 8.7

Karl Malone.reason: capstone pick 2026-09-06 (rule A) — MVP, BPM 8.3, VORP 7.8

Hakeem Olajuwon.reason: capstone pick 2026-09-06 (rule A: his only card is the Raptor stint) — DPOY, BPM 7.5, VORP 7.8

Vince Carter.reason: capstone pick 2026-09-06 (rule A) — 27.6 ppg in Toronto, BPM 7.6

John Wall.reason: the Wizards reward, 2026-09-18 — the user: "Use the best card, if it's a super season, make it as such"; 2016-17 is his best season by the rule (BPM+VORP), so it IS his Super Season card, migrated into team-rewards as Zubac's was (team-rewards-2026.json migrated.WAS)

Elton Brand.reason: 2026-09-18 — the user: "Make sure all those guys get super seasons and rookies too"; his best season by the rule (79 G, 3099 min; 2002-03 is the Clippers reward, a Throwback)

Gilbert Arenas.reason: 2026-09-18 — the user: "Make sure all those guys get super seasons and rookies too"; his best season by the rule (80 G, 3384 min)

DeAndre Jordan.reason: 2026-09-18 — the user liked his 2017-18, but asked that the card be his BEST season by the same test ("Use the best card"): 2014-15 scores 1.615 to 2017-18's 0.777, so 2014-15 is the card

Anthony Parker.reason: 2026-09-18 — the outgoing Toronto reward (re-picked to Vince Carter 1999-2000). The identity sweep found 2006-07 IS his best season by the rule, so it is his Super Season card rather than a Throwback; prices under the gold line (tier-down look). He has no rookie card and cannot (1997-98: 37 G, 196 min fails the bar)

Dominique Wilkins.reason: 2026-09-24 — the user, adding his Celtics and Spurs Dissonance cards: "He'll need a rookie and Super Season as well". 1986-87 is his best season by the box-score rule (BPM 5.5, VORP 5.6); the value pick weighs every eligible season (all their logs fetched first)
